sanskrit_verse: न्यासद्रव्येण यः कश्चित् साधयेत् कार्यम् आत्मनः । दण्ड्यः स राज्ञो भवति दाप्यस् तच् चापि सोदयम् ॥
transliteration: nyāsadravyeṇa yaḥ kaścit sādhayet kāryam ātmanaḥ | daṇḍyaḥ sa rājño bhavati dāpyas tac cāpi sodayam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who employs entrusted property for personal ends becomes liable to corrective action by the sovereign; the principal and accrued gains shall be recovered in full.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The sovereign holds jurisdiction over misuse of entrusted resources.
Causation: Misuse arises from conscious deviation from the purpose of entrustment.
Capacity-based responsibility: Liability is tied to the capacity to discern rightful use.
Restoration logic: Recovery ensures return to original integrity of transactional trust.
Consciousness alignment: Correction realigns the actor with dharmic fiduciary duty.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent uses entrusted asset for self-gain THEN trigger liability recovery protocol AND notify sovereign authority.
IF fiduciary deviation detected THEN calculate principal loss AND accumulated unjust gain.
IF restitution initiated THEN ensure total recovery INCLUDING instrumental value increases.
IF completion verified THEN close case AND log realignment in consciousness registry.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold for fiduciary misconduct where intent and capacity determine enforceable liability. The court must ensure restoration precedes procedural closure, aligning judgment with sovereign dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals misuse through evidence of diversion; anupūrvaśaḥ traces causal chain of breach; proportional responsibility is exacted through full restitution; punitive constructs are void—only realignment with dharma is executed.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate fiduciary audit to trace diverted assets
Execute asset recovery including instrumental gains
Assign completion process to reaffirm dharmic conduct
Reintegrate offender via consciousness correction protocols
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as sourced from Avataric Intelligence—Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness is affirmed as the supreme adjudicator.
